sentences.text:
Also heard Mr. B. Sarma,
learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State of Assam.

This is an application made under Section 439 Cr. P.C. seeking bail by the accused/petitioner,
namely, Rojit Ali @ Sahil Ahmed @ Rojitulla who was arrested on 06.06.2020 in connection with Special (POCSO) Case No. 35/2022 registered under Section 376(2)(i) of IPC read with Section 4 of POCSO Act arising out Panigaon P.S. Case No. 38/2020.

Scanned copies of the record of Special (POCSO) Case No. 35/2022 registered under Section 376(2)(i) of IPC read with Section 4 of POCSO Act and case diary of Act arising out Panigaon P.S.
Case No. 38/2020 is received.
Perused the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. and under Section 161 of Cr.P.C.
Also the statements of other witnesses recorded by the I.O.
The victim has specifically implicated the accused.
The victim is not yet been examined by the prosecution in the trial.
There are sufficient incriminating materials against the present petitioner.
Considering the nature of material collected by the I.O., as well as the gravity of the offence, this Court is of the view that the petitioner has not been able to make out a case for grant of bail.
Accordingly, this bail application is dismissed.
